aboutH2: Breakthrough Recovery Centre: Residential Addiction and Mental Health Care in Wasaga Beach
intro: Breakthrough Recovery Centre is a private residential treatment centre in Wasaga Beach, Ontario, a short walk from the Georgian Bay shoreline. It opened in 2026 and takes adults 18 and over for addiction, behavioural addictions and mental health concerns, often all three at once.

Care starts with on-site medical detox when it is needed and continues into a residential stay of 4, 6 or 8 weeks. Each week includes one-to-one counselling, group therapy and psychoeducation, with a trauma specialist on the team. Aftercare runs for up to a year after you go home.

pillars.title: A House Among the Trees, a Short Walk from the Bay
pillars.body: The centre is a white two-storey building on 32nd Street North in Wasaga Beach, set back under tall trees with a covered entrance and a lawn out front. Inside there are private and shared bedrooms, a dining room where residents eat together, a lounge lined with bookshelves, a games room with a pool table and a small gym. The beach is a few minutes away on foot, and the team uses the water and the shoreline as part of the program. Residents do not leave the property without staff or an approved plan.

pillars.title: A Plan for Home, Then a Year of Check-ins
pillars.body: Discharge planning starts while you are still in residence. The Compass Pathways program works through housing, job hunting and résumés, school plans and budgeting so you leave with a written plan and a list of people to call. After that, the Horizons group meets once a week on Zoom for an hour, led by an addiction and mental health counsellor. The Anchor program keeps a weekly phone or text check-in with your counsellor going for up to a year, and you can still call after that.

pillars.title: Room for the People Who Love You
pillars.body: Families can take part with the client's consent. Bridge Sessions are family therapy sessions run by a therapist once the client is settled, two in a 4-week stay and three in a 6-week stay, in person or online. Circle of Healing is separate. One loved one, usually the person paying, gets private sessions with a different therapist, and nothing they say is passed to the client's team. Visiting is on Sundays, and first-time visitors sign a waiver and stay on site for the visit.

overview: Breakthrough Recovery Centre runs as a private, physician-overseen residential program in Wasaga Beach, in Simcoe County. A typical week includes two sessions with a primary counsellor, one with a secondary counsellor and two psychotherapy sessions, around daily group work and education on relapse prevention, coping skills and emotional regulation. Psychiatric assessment and medication management are available when clinically needed.

location.intro: Breakthrough Recovery Centre is on 32nd Street North in Wasaga Beach, in Simcoe County, a few minutes' walk from the Georgian Bay shoreline. Toronto is about an hour and 45 minutes south by car, Barrie about 40 minutes, and Collingwood about 20 minutes along the bay.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's own website and public listings. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: Is Breakthrough Recovery Centre open and taking admissions?
faqs.a: Yes. Breakthrough Recovery Centre opened in Wasaga Beach in 2026 and marked its grand opening with the Town of Wasaga Beach in August 2026. Admissions answers the phone 24 hours a day at (705) 352-9600, and the centre says it aims to admit people within 24 to 48 hours of first contact.

faqs.q: How much does Breakthrough Recovery Centre cost?
faqs.a: The centre does not publish its prices. Fees depend on which program and how many weeks you choose, and admissions gives you the cost in writing before you are admitted. It is private pay, so OHIP does not cover it, but you can pay in instalments and use credit card, debit, money order or cash. Card payments carry a processing fee.

Residential stays run 4, 6 or 8 weeks, called the North Star, Guiding Light and Lighthouse programs. The centre's FAQ also mentions a 12-week option, so ask admissions if you think you need longer. Your length of stay is agreed after a clinical assessment.

faqs.q: Does Breakthrough Recovery Centre offer detox?
faqs.a: Yes. Medically supervised detox, called the Harbour Program, happens on site under physician oversight with nursing care, and you move straight into residential treatment once you are stable. It covers alcohol, opioids, benzodiazepines, prescription drugs and stimulants. People who need hospital-level medical or psychiatric care are referred elsewhere.

faqs.q: What does Breakthrough Recovery Centre treat?
faqs.a: It treats alcohol and drug addiction, behavioural addictions such as gambling, compulsive sexual behaviour and problem gaming, and mental health concerns including anxiety, depression, trauma, PTSD and burnout. Dual diagnosis is a main focus, and you can be admitted for a behavioural addiction or a mental health concern without any substance use.

faqs.q: Where is Breakthrough Recovery Centre and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 135 32nd Street North in Wasaga Beach, Ontario, a few steps from the Georgian Bay shoreline. It is about an hour and 45 minutes north of Toronto by car and around 40 minutes from Barrie. If you are flying in, admissions can arrange a driver from the airport, though you pay for the ride.

faqs.q: Can I use my benefits or other funding?
faqs.a: Some extended health plans cover part or all of residential addiction and mental health treatment, so call your insurer first and ask about inpatient care. The centre gives receipts and paperwork for claims. It also works with First Nations communities, Bands and funding representatives when funding may be available for Indigenous clients.

Yes, with your consent. Bridge Sessions are family therapy sessions led by a therapist, two in a 4-week stay and three in a 6-week stay, held on site or online. Circle of Healing gives one loved one their own private sessions with a separate therapist. Family can also visit on Sundays once you are ready.

Before you go home, the Compass Pathways program helps you plan for housing, work, school and money. After discharge you can join the Horizons group, a one-hour Zoom session every week run by an addiction and mental health counsellor. The Anchor program adds a weekly phone or text check-in with your counsellor for up to a year.

faqs.q: Do I need a doctor's referral?
faqs.a: No. You or a family member can call admissions directly. A confidential clinical assessment covering substance use, mental health, medical history and medications decides whether residential care, detox or the hybrid outpatient program is the right fit.
